next_step_exact.goal: root-cause why the startup pacing floor starves plan_fec_parity
established_facts: plan_fec_parity runs unconditionally each turn after DATA/recovery
it drains pending_fec only while pacer.try_send(p.size) succeeds
this scenario feeds NO AppData - only Timer::Pto - so parity is the only pending work and cannot be starved by DATA competition
the floor RAISES send_rate, which should increase tokens, so the mechanism is counter-intuitive and must be measured
next_step_exact.method: instrument pacer.tokens()/rate()/burst_cap() per tick with the floor ON vs OFF and identify which blocks try_send
next_step_exact.prime_suspect: set_burst_cap clamping (tokens = min(tokens, burst_cap)) interacting with the floor-driven rate
